mainEntity.name: Can schema markup be implemented on all website platforms, such as WordPress or Shopify?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, schema markup can be implemented on virtually all website platforms. For content management systems (CMS) like WordPress, there are numerous plugins (e.g., Yoast SEO, Rank Math) that automate or simplify schema generation and insertion. For e-commerce platforms like Shopify, dedicated apps or direct theme code modifications can be used to add product or local business schema. Custom-built websites require manual JSON-LD integration. Regardless of the platform, the principles of selecting relevant schema and ensuring data accuracy remain consistent.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, schema markup can be implemented on all platforms, often via plugins for CMS like WordPress, apps/theme edits for Shopify, or manual JSON-LD for custom sites.
